Notifications section: paragraph: New emails, SMS and failed webhook deliveries. Saved in this browser only, and applied at once.

Opened events section: paragraph: email.opened and sms.opened stand in for the recipient reading the message.
paragraph: Opening an email or scrolling an SMS into view counts as the recipient reading it.
switch: Fire opened events when I view messages
radio: First open only One event per message, like most providers report.
radio: Every open An event each time, for testing open counters.
Chaos section: paragraph: Make SMTP fail on purpose to test retries and error handling. SMS failures use the failure rate in SMS settings.

OTP patterns section: paragraph: Tried in order on every new email and SMS; the first capture group of the first match is the code.
Connection section: paragraph: Point your app at SendMock. Provider SDKs are below, under Provider APIs; recipes are in the docs.

About section: paragraph: Issue forms open on GitHub with your version, channel, OS and browser filled in; nothing you captured is sent.
paragraph: Off by default: SendMock never calls out unless you choose Manual or Daily. Stable installs are offered stable releases; beta installs betas and stables.
radio: Off SendMock never calls out.
radio: Manual Only when you press Check for updates.
radio: Daily On start and once a day; a new version shows in the notifications.
Delete all emails dialog: paragraph: Every captured email, its attachments and its SMTP session link are removed. Configuration stays.
Delete all SMS dialog: paragraph: Every captured SMS and WhatsApp message is removed. Numbers and services stay.
Reset to seed dialog: paragraph: All traffic is wiped and the configuration goes back to the seed file. Changes not exported to the seed are lost.
